scenarios.name: The First Sliver's own cascade exiles the top card and casts it for free
scenarios.ruling: Cascade triggers when you cast the spell. It exiles cards from the top of your library until a nonland card with a lesser mana value is exiled, and you may cast that card without paying its mana cost. The cascade trigger and the free spell both resolve before the spell with cascade.

scenarios.name: A Sliver spell you cast gets cascade from The First Sliver
scenarios.ruling: The First Sliver's last ability grants cascade to Sliver spells you cast, so casting a one-mana Sliver exiles cards until a nonland card with mana value 0 is exiled and lets you cast it free.

scenarios.name: A non-Sliver spell you cast gets no cascade from The First Sliver
scenarios.ruling: The granted cascade applies only to Sliver spells; a Hill Giant spell has no cascade ability, so nothing is exiled from the library.
